text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
These document out outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1 
 , which depending on external/internal leakage.
This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (open / closed only 
 state).
Technical Specification:
Type of valve | Silent stainless special check valve
Size | 16"
Body material | Carbon steel
Medium | Raw water
Joint | flanshed
Packing | buna non-adjustable
Shaft | 317 st. Stl.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou Elfetouh Shata, tested by 
 eng. Ali Abd Elslam, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
 director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head 
 sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document accepted by 
 eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
 EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC planning & financial 
 prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head 
 sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.
Wear safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate valve mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this valve.
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Spanner, 
 gasket, spacer ring.
Cleaning 
 liquid.
Blanco, anti 
 seize.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure the valve was out 
 of operation and the pressure inside the pipeline connected to the valve must 
 be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is 
 drained.
Clean from foreign 
 material.
Lap the disk wear or 
 cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it 
 is bad.
Make machining for stem 
 or replace the defect.
Replace the pen if it is 
 wear.
Retighten the gland if it 
 is leakage or replace it.
